why: inputTokens is 1200 + 35908, NOT the raw input_tokens field. The engine's `input_tokens` counts only the UNCACHED remainder of a turn; on a thread of any length the cache fields carry almost all of it. Measured against the real binary: input_tokens 2, cache_creation 14089, cache_read 23065 — a usage panel built on the raw field would have displayed 2 instead of 37156, which reads as fabricated data because it effectively is
